name: Sen no Tomoshibi no Mukou ni ~Outer Ring Tale~
source:
Year in early 2200s, space pioneering era. Main character Ares is a bounty hunter taking various job on requests. His aim is to save 50 million credits and organize an expedition to the Second Galaxy where his father got missing. There may be secondary goals to help heroines in need, but the journey goes on as long as a star named "dream" keeps shining in people's mind.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
22世纪初，太空开拓时代。主人公阿瑞斯是一名接受各种委托的赏金猎人。他的目标是攒够5000万信用点，并组织一支探险队前往父亲失踪的第二银河。帮助陷入困境的女主角们或许是次要目标，但只要名为“梦想”的星辰仍在人们心中闪耀，旅程就会继续。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
